key_insight: UniSpine-GS uses a physics-aware Gaussian 3D representation to generate consistent multi-view spine images across modalities without explicit 3D reconstruction.
clinical_relevance: It may enable lower-cost, more scalable spinal assessment when full 3D imaging is limited or unavailable.
method: Learns a geometry-aware Gaussian scene representation for novel-view spine rendering.
Adds SPWM, a structure-guided loss reweighting strategy to sharpen boundaries and local anatomical detail.
Designed to improve cross-modality generalization between CT and ultrasound.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on CTSpine3D and a newly built 3D fetal ultrasound dataset (FeSpine3D), where it reportedly outperformed existing methods across all metrics.
watch_item: Performance may depend on dataset quality and view coverage, and cross-modality deployment could still face domain-shift and integration challenges.
paper_title: UniSpine-GS: An Efficient Physics-Aware Gaussian Framework for Cross-Modality Multi-view Spine Image Synthesis
